style: Epic painterly fantasy card illustration, highly detailed, cinematic composition, dramatic rim lighting and deep shadows, rich cosmic colour.
race: The Lost Races, four peoples the dark nearly took, each unmistakably alien and unlike the others: the Nyxari, gaunt void-stalkers wrapped in tattered living shadow, faces hidden under hoods with only cold violet eyes showing, wisps of darkness trailing from them; the Korrath, broad, heavy forge-smiths of living stone and dark iron, glowing orange seams of molten metal running through their armoured hides, carrying great hammers and slab shields; the Seren, slender, serene star-readers in deep blue and silver robes embroidered with constellations, crystal astrolabes and orbiting motes of starlight around their raised hands; and the Pyrr, flare-born beings of living fire, bodies of white-hot flame and embers, flickering crowns of flame.
framing: Wide 16:9 landscape. The painted scene fills the whole picture edge to edge: its sky or background continues right up to the top edge, with open sky across the top quarter (never a flat colour band, blank strip, letterbox bar, border or frame). The main figure's head sits about 40% of the way down and a little to one side of centre, never at the very top; keep faces and key details away from the bottom centre of the picture. The painting runs right to the bottom edge with no emblem, seal, logo, line or border anywhere. No text, no lettering.

cards.mode_lost_races: The four Lost Races stand together for the first time on a broken ridge of a dying world at the edge of the galaxy, seen from a little below: the Korrath forge-smith planted in the middle with hammer and shield, the Pyrr flare-born beside them blazing, the Seren star-reader raising an astrolabe of starlight, the Nyxari void-stalker half-melted into shadow at the edge. Behind them a vast ragged nebula of violet, ember-orange and deep blue, a distant red giant sun low on the horizon, and ruins of an ancient stellar gate. A sense of exiles returning: wary, proud, unbowed.
